description: Self-hosted MCP gateway and company brain for AI agents. Turn any REST/OpenAPI, SOAP/WSDL, GraphQL, OData or SQL API into MCP tools for Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot, no code: 774 pre-built adapters for ERP and e-commerce (SAP S/4HANA, SAP Business One, Odoo, Xentral, JTL-Wawi, weclapp, Shopware, WooCommerce, Amazon Seller, Kaufland, OTTO…) and more. File Search over SFTP/WebDAV/S3 file servers, company memory, AI skills and a knowledge graph shared by every AI client. Per-tool response mapping, OAuth2/RBAC/SSO/SCIM, audit log. Open source under AGPL-3.0.
